reviews.body: Great Value and Perfect for Parties The Pureegg Plastic Table Cloth Disposable 10 Pack, 84'' Round Table Cloths worked perfectly for my event. The size (84 inches round) fit our tables well and gave them a clean, neat look. These disposable tableclot...
Great color and quality. Will definitely buy them again and would highly recommend.

I’m really happy with these tablecloths. The material is thicker than I expected, so it doesn’t tear easily like some other disposable ones. They fit the table well and look clean and neat, which is perfect for gatherings or everyday use.

Great product I used it for my baby shower! Good product for the price. My only thing was it was a little see through which was fine. It’s definitely a thin plastic. Need to be careful not to rip it. But it worked great for my party, lasted all day.
